finalProject.title: AWS Architecture Project
finalProject.subtitle: Emerging Final Project
finalProject.description: An AWS-hosted student records site for XYZ University. The presentation documents an application tier across two Availability Zones, with an Application Load Balancer and EC2 Auto Scaling, plus a private RDS MySQL database.
objectives: Learn how to build and configure cloud storage services.
technologies: Amazon VPC with public and private subnets
EC2 Auto Scaling with two t3.micro Linux instances
Amazon RDS for MySQL in a private database subnet group
finalProject.contribution: Created instances, deployed them across two Availability Zones, and configured them to communicate with one another.
finalProject.challenge: Troubleshooting significant errors extended the activity over multiple days and took longer than expected.
finalProject.reflection: I learned how to set up a cloud database.
finalProject.results: The presentation reports that the student records site was live, a new student record was saved and listed, and data was stored in RDS.
finalProject.costEstimate: The AWS Pricing Calculator estimate reports USD 97.97 per month and USD 1,175.64 for 12 months. These are estimated costs, not actual charges.
